title: 출국대기실 운영 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Search of Body and Personal Belongings)
(1) Where there are reasonable grounds to suspect that an admitted foreigner possesses any of the following items, the responsible official may inspect the person's body, clothing, and personal belongings:
1. Items likely to impair the safety or order of the departure waiting room;
2. Items likely to harm the admitted foreigner's safety, health, or hygiene.
(2) An inspection under paragraph (1) shall be conducted by a responsible official of the same sex. Where no same-sex responsible official is available, a same-sex person designated by the head, etc. may conduct the inspection; where the admitted foreigner is a sexual minority, a person of another sex designated by the head, etc. may conduct it while respecting the person's wishes.
